description:
• Brand introduction:
Icecartel sells hip hop moissanite diamond jewelry mainly in the US. Average transaction value is around $1000.
• Product description:
We sell moissanite diamond chains, pendants, bracelets, rings and earrings for men.
• USP (Unique Selling Point):
We are producing high quality moissanite jewelry, budget friendly alterntive to diamond jewelry.
Moissanite reflects more light than diamonds. Moissanite reflects rainbow colors under the sun while diamond only reflects white light.
Our shipping times to the US are 2-5 days. We ship with UPS or DHL Express.
• Payment terms:
For affiliates we can currently do bank transfers or pay by debit card. Our site accepts Visa, Mastercard and Amex cards, in the near future we are able to accept Google and Apple pay.
• Other information:
Contact me on whatsapp +1 404 666-6359 for more information

ICECARTEL.COM Affiliate Program Terms and Conditions

Welcome to ICECARTEL.COM! Thank you for joining our Affiliate Program. By participating in this program, you agree to adhere to the following Terms and Conditions. Please read them carefully. If you do not agree to these Terms and Conditions in their entirety, you are not authorized to register as an affiliate or participate in the program in any manner.

We do NOT accept coupon sites, referral sites, discount sites, or any websites of that nature as affiliates. Payouts to such affiliates will be declined. We are primarily seeking affiliates from social media platforms such as YouTube, Instagram, TikTok, and similar channels.

These Terms and Conditions govern the relationship between ICECARTEL.COM (the “Merchant,” “we,” or “us”) and the affiliate (“you” or “Affiliate”). By registering, you agree to be legally bound by these conditions.

1. Approval or Rejection of Registration

2. Affiliate Eligibility

Affiliates must meet the following criteria to participate in the program:

  • Affiliates may not operate coupon sites, discount sites, or referral-based websites.
  • Affiliates must primarily promote ICECARTEL.COM through social media platforms, blogs, or other approved channels.
  • Affiliates must adhere to ethical promotional practices and must not engage in fraudulent or misleading behavior.

Failure to meet these criteria will result in immediate termination from the program.

3. Termination Policy

We reserve the right to terminate any affiliate account at any time, at our sole discretion, if we feel the affiliate does not represent the best interests of ICECARTEL.COM or violates any of the terms outlined in this agreement. Termination may occur for reasons including, but not limited to:

  • Any action that damages or could damage the reputation of ICECARTEL.COM.

Once an affiliate is terminated, all pending commissions will be nullified and will not be paid out.

4. Affiliate Links and Coupons

  • Affiliates are given a unique referral link upon joining the program. You may also generate affiliate links for specific products or collections through your dashboard.
  • If a customer clicks on multiple affiliate links, the most recent link clicked will be credited for the sale.
  • Affiliates may be assigned a coupon code for promotional purposes. If a customer uses both an affiliate link and a coupon code, the affiliate will not receive double commissions.
  • Affiliates are prohibited from promoting unauthorized coupons or discounts. Violation of this rule will result in immediate termination.

5. Commissions and Payments

  • Commissions are calculated based on the order value, excluding taxes, shipping costs, and any additional fees.
  • Payments will be issued only for successfully completed transactions. Transactions that result in chargebacks, refunds, or cancellations will not earn commissions.
  • Affiliates must provide accurate payment details in their dashboard to receive payments.
  • Payments are made according to the schedule outlined on the Affiliate Guide page.
  • All commissions are subject to a fair use policy, which gives ICECARTEL.COM the right to review and verify all referrals before payment.

6. Network Feature (Optional)

If the Network feature is enabled, affiliates may invite others to join the program using a referral link. Affiliates who bring in new referrals will earn network commissions based on the performance of their downline affiliates. Details about network commissions can be found in your dashboard.

7. Prohibited Activities

Affiliates may not engage in the following:

  • Self-referrals or purchasing products through their own affiliate link.
  • Misrepresentation of ICECARTEL.COM products, services, or policies.
  • Use of misleading, unethical, or prohibited promotional methods.
  • Violations of intellectual property rights or trademark infringement.

Affiliates found engaging in prohibited activities will be terminated immediately, and all pending commissions will be forfeited.

8. Cookie Tracking

We use cookies to track affiliate referrals. Cookies remain valid for the duration specified during registration (e.g., 30 days). If a customer does not allow cookies or clears their cookies, we cannot track their activity, and no commission will be paid.

9. Changes to the Program

ICECARTEL.COM reserves the right to update or modify these Terms and Conditions at any time. Affiliates will be notified of significant changes, and continued participation in the program constitutes acceptance of the updated terms.

10. Removal from the Program

Affiliates wishing to leave the program may do so by contacting martin@icecartel.com. ICECARTEL.COM may also remove affiliates at its sole discretion, with or without notice.

11. Limitation of Liability

12. Governing Law

13. Acceptance of Terms

By registering for the ICECARTEL.COM Affiliate Program, you acknowledge that you have read, understood, and agree to be bound by these Terms and Conditions.

If you have any questions or need further clarification, please contact martin@icecartel.com.

Go forward and refer! We’re excited to have you as part of the ICECARTEL.COM Affiliate Program.
